def test_flip_case():
    # Test mixed case string
    assert flip_case("Hello World") == "hELLO wORLD"
    
    # Test all lowercase
    assert flip_case("hello") == "HELLO"
    
    # Test all uppercase
    assert flip_case("WORLD") == "world"
    
    # Test empty string
    assert flip_case("") == ""
    
    # Test string with no letters
    assert flip_case("12345!@#$%") == "12345!@#$%"
    
    # Test single character lowercase
    assert flip_case("a") == "A"
    
    # Test single character uppercase
    assert flip_case("A") == "a"
    
    # Test string with spaces and punctuation
    assert flip_case("PyThOn 3.9 Is_Awesome!") == "pYtHoN 3.9 iS_AWESOME!"
    
    # Test double flip returns original
    original = "Test String 123"
    assert flip_case(flip_case(original)) == original
    
    # Test with unicode characters
    assert flip_case("ÉÀÜ") == "éàü"
    assert flip_case("éàü") == "ÉÀÜ"
    
    print("All tests passed!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_flip_case()
